passage:
hypothesis — 假设；有待检验的命题
The claim on the screen says: “Remote work always increases productivity.” I want us to treat that sentence as a hypothesis, not a fact.

scope — 范围；适用界限
In academic terms, we are looking for scope conditions—the specific situations in which a claim is likely to be true.

variable — 变量；可能变化的因素
A broad claim often hides a second variable.

transparency — 透明度；公开说明做法
The difference is transparency.

isolation — 孤立感；隔离状态
Priya: In our survey, we also found that people who worked remotely for more than two years reported more isolation.

testable — 可检验的
Instead, we can rewrite the claim with limits: “Remote work can increase productivity for small teams with clear tasks, at least in the short term.” That is a narrower, more testable statement.

exception — 例外
If a claim says “always,” one clear exception is enough to show it is too broad.

transfer — 迁移；把规则用到新情境
That is how transfer works: you carry the rule to a fresh situation.
